            "widgets_values": [
              "A three-quarter side profile shot captured from a slightly low, stationary camera angle, this image frames a joyful hiker against the jagged, dramatic peaks of the Dolomites, where the elevated perspective emphasizes both the grandeur of the alpine landscape and the upward, hopeful tilt of his gaze.
